1: // Simple Meteor Dodge game targeting <canvas id="game"></canvas>
2: (function(){
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if(!canvas) return; // canvas must exist
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
7:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
8: 
9:   // Player ship
10:   const ship = { w:40, h:20, x:W/2-20, y:H-30, speed:5 };
11:   const keys = { left:false, right:false };
12:   document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')keys.left=true; if(e.key==='ArrowRight')keys.right=true;});
13:   document.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')keys.left=false; if(e.key==='ArrowRight')keys.right=false;});
14: 
15:   // Meteors
16:   const meteors = [];
17:   let spawnTimer=0, spawnInterval=60, // frames
18:       elapsed=0, lastTime=0,
19:       gameOver=false;
20: 
21:   function spawn(){
22:     const size = 20+Math.random()*30;
23:     meteors.push({x:Math.random()*(W-size), y:-size, size, speed:2+elapsed*0.02});
24:   }
25:   function update(dt){
26:     if(keys.left) ship.x = Math.max(0, ship.x-ship.speed);
27:     if(keys.right) ship.x = Math.min(W-ship.w, ship.x+ship.speed);
28:     // meteors
29:     for(let i=meteors.length-1;i>=0;i--){
30:       const m=meteors[i];
31:       m.y += m.speed;
32:       // collision
33:       if(m.x < ship.x+ship.w && m.x+m.size > ship.x && m.y < ship.y+ship.h && m.y+m.size > ship.y){
34:         gameOver=true;
35:       }
36:       // remove off-screen
37:       if(m.y>H) meteors.splice(i,1);
38:     }
39:     spawnTimer++;
40:     if(spawnTimer>=spawnInterval){ spawnTimer=0; spawn(); }
41:     elapsed += dt/1000;
42:   }
43:   function draw(){
44:     ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
45:     // ship
46:     ctx.fillStyle='#0af';
47:     ctx.fillRect(ship.x, ship.y, ship.w, ship.h);
48:     // meteors
49:     ctx.fillStyle='#a44';
50:     meteors.forEach(m=>{ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x+m.size/2, m.y+m.size/2, m.size/2,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); });
51:     // score
52:     ctx.fillStyle='#000';
53:     ctx.font='16px sans-serif';
54:     ctx.fillText('Score: '+Math.floor(elapsed),10,20);
55:     if(gameOver){
56:       ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
57:       ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
58:       ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
59:       ctx.font='30px sans-serif';
60:       ctx.fillText('Game Over',W/2-80,H/2);
61:     }
62:   }
63:   function loop(timestamp){
64:     if(!lastTime) lastTime=timestamp;
65:     const dt = timestamp-lastTime;
66:     lastTime=timestamp;
67:     if(!gameOver){
68:       update(dt);
69:       draw();
70:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
71:     } else {
72:       draw();
73:     }
74:   }
75:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
76: })();
